import ast,hashlib,io,json,os,subprocess,sys,unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch
cases=[
 ('春游未删除满员编号','removed = spans[1+seen.index(n)]','removed = spans[0]','test_outing_removes_only_last_insider_and_preserves_outsiders'),
 ('春游遗漏外班保证','and any(x > n for x in seen)','and True','test_outing_removes_only_last_insider_and_preserves_outsiders'),
 ('放过严格速度上界','if max(speeds) < 1000:','if max(speeds) <= 1000:','test_plank_scaling_preserves_positive_height_and_speed_order'),
 ('速度缩放错方向','Decimal(x).scaleb(-power)','Decimal(x).scaleb(power)','test_plank_scaling_preserves_positive_height_and_speed_order'),
 ('水平距离未同步缩小','distance //= factor','distance //= 1','test_plank_scaling_preserves_positive_height_and_speed_order'),
 ('漏查非正所需高度','assert required_height(distance, speeds) > 0','assert True','test_plank_scaling_preserves_positive_height_and_speed_order'),
 ('怪物时间错用生命值','map(str,times[:200])','map(str,hp[:200])','test_assist_keeps_original_pair_offsets'),
 ('怪物截断越界','map(str,hp[:200])','map(str,hp[:201])','test_assist_keeps_original_pair_offsets'),
 ('多删除一条已声明依赖','lines[:2+m]','lines[:1+m]','test_quantum_removes_only_undeclared_last_line'),
 ('擅自接受任意多余依赖','assert n == 2000 and m == 10000 and len(edges) == m+1','assert True','test_quantum_removes_only_undeclared_last_line'),
 ('排名缩成零基下标','str(len(vocabulary)).encode()','str(len(vocabulary)-1).encode()','test_document_rank_changes_only_rank_token'),
 ('词汇计数按总词数非去重','vocabulary = {word for row in rows for word in row.split()}','vocabulary = [word for row in rows for word in row.split()]','test_document_rank_changes_only_rank_token')]
p=Path('scripts/gmyhf_review_fixes.py');original=p.read_text();results=[]
try:
 for name,old,new,test in cases:
  assert original.count(old)==1,(name,original.count(old));p.write_text(original.replace(old,new))
  run=subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/python3.11','-B','-m','unittest','tests.test_gmyhf_early_structure.EarlyStructureTests.'+test],capture_output=True,env=dict(os.environ,PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1'))
  assert run.returncode!=0,name
  results.append({'mutation':name,'detected':True,'exit_code':run.returncode});p.write_text(original)
finally:p.write_text(original)
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path.cwd()));from tests import test_gmyhf_early_structure as tests
for n,name,old,new,test in [
 (23554,'遗漏最后一个走失学号','range(1,n+1)','range(1,n)','test_outing_reference_against_direct_counts'),
 (25580,'半数阈值错误','n-(n//2+1)','n-(n//2)','test_plank_reference_against_each_candidate_height'),
 (27307,'漏计小A消灭的怪物','needed-time-1','needed-time','test_assist_reference_against_all_subsets'),
 (30222,'错误取最短任务完成时间','max(done)','min(done)','test_quantum_reference_against_schedule_dp'),
 (31193,'词频翻倍','freq[token]+=1','freq[token]+=2','test_document_reference_counts_repeated_words_once_per_line')]:
 proof=json.loads(Path(f'collab/gmyhf-{n}-authored-admin-review.json').read_text())['entries'][0]['authored_reference'];source=proof['source'];assert source.count(old)==1;tree=ast.parse(source.replace(old,new));tree.body=[v for v in tree.body if isinstance(v,(ast.Import,ast.ImportFrom,ast.FunctionDef))];ns={};exec(compile(tree,'<自产参考变异>','exec'),ns)
 with patch.object(tests,'reference',return_value=ns[proof['function']]):
  run=unittest.TextTestRunner(stream=io.StringIO()).run(tests.EarlyStructureTests(test));assert not run.wasSuccessful(),name
 results.append({'mutation':name,'detected':True,'failures':len(run.failures),'errors':len(run.errors)})
s=Path(__file__).read_text();Path('collab/gmyhf-review-fixes-batch19-mutations.json').write_text(json.dumps({'batch':19,'results':results,'procedure_source':s,'procedure_sha256':hashlib.sha256(s.encode()).hexdigest()},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n');print(len(results),'种变异检出，源码已恢复')
